aha: One notch dig drops two stones down the jellyfish shaft (killing it), but the shaft is three deep, so a third stone must follow before any pearl. Kill the vault crab (its den is three cells) with the stone over the vault pit, open the vault plug from below, push the vault pearl down the floor chimney and deliver pearls one at a time.
deadlocks: Dropping a pearl after only the two notch stones: it lands below road level and is lost.
Pushing the vault pearl while the crab lives, or before the vault pit is plugged: it gets jammed against the crab or falls into the pit.
Dropping a second pearl into the shaft while another pearl waits on the road to its left (e.g. at the chimney foot): they jam.
Pushing a pearl past the air capsule or undug road: blocked, and the diver cannot get around it.
timing: crab crush from the notch 26% -> 50% (crab den shortened to x=4..6, sand plug x=7..8 dug from below after the kill); jelly 83% unchanged
